overall_goal: Add the sliced mushrooms to the pan and cook them.

goals.description: Transfer the sliced mushrooms from the bowl into the frying pan.
goals.rationale: The person picks up the bowl of mushrooms, pours them into the pan, shakes out the remaining pieces, and sets the empty bowl aside.

goals.description: Stir the mushrooms and onions in the pan to cook them evenly.
goals.rationale: The person uses a spatula to continuously stir the food in the pan, adjusting the pan's position and tapping off food residue from the spatula as needed.
